name: Tapcart
description:
Tapcart is the mobile app platform for Shopify brands. This MCP server connects Claude directly to your Tapcart apps, so your team can analyze performance, run push campaigns, and build App Studio content without switching context.

Analytics — Browse the metrics catalog and query app performance data, so you can ask questions about installs, engagement, and revenue in plain language and get answers grounded in your own numbers.

Push campaigns — List, schedule, update, and cancel push notification campaigns, and send a test push to one device before anything goes out. Campaigns must be scheduled for a future time; there is no immediate campaign send, so there is always a window to review before a message reaches customers.

Segments — List existing customer segments, inspect the available filter vocabulary, and create new segments to target campaigns.

Screen layouts — Build and ship App Studio screens end to end with no local tooling. Clone a published screen into a draft, arrange the blocks on it, then open a login-free preview link that renders the draft at phone width on your real storefront. Draft links follow the draft, so you reload to see each edit; publishing makes it the live screen and freezes it as a checkpoint you can clone from again.

App Studio — Manage blocks and components across their full lifecycle: list, version, preview, and publish. Inspect and configure block dependencies so you can see what a change affects before shipping it.

Discovery — Search Tapcart's documentation and list the apps available to your account.

Access is via OAuth 2.0: each member signs in with their own Tapcart credentials and inherits their existing permissions. Of the 34 tools, 18 are read-only queries. Every write tool defaults to a plan mode that shows the exact change before anything is committed, and only acts when explicitly applied.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Tapcart to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Tapcart to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.tapcart.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Tapcart MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tapcart lists 34 MCP tools, including tapcart_apps_list, tapcart_block_get, tapcart_block_preview, tapcart_block_push, tapcart_block_version_set, tapcart_block_versions_list, tapcart_blocks_list, tapcart_campaign_cancel, tapcart_campaign_schedule, tapcart_campaign_update, tapcart_campaigns_list, and tapcart_component_get.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Tapcart?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Tapcart in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Tapcart requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Tapcart is developed by Tapcart. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
